description: This file defines the class InMemoryCalendarSyncConfig, a test double implementation of CalendarSyncConfig used for unit testing. It provides in-memory storage for calendar synchronization configuration settings, simulating database-backed configuration for testing purposes.

classes.name: InMemoryCalendarSyncConfig
classes.description: A test double class that stores calendar sync configuration in memory, used for testing code without database access.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve the value for a given configuration key.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieve all configuration data as an array.

methods.name: getRunAsyncValue
methods.description: Check if asynchronous sync is enabled.

methods.name: enableCalendarSyncLogicHooks
methods.description: Check if calendar sync logic hooks are enabled.

methods.name: setConfigValue
methods.description: Set a specific configuration key to a value.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Reset configuration data to default preset values.
